name: Postiz CLI (schedule posts everywhere)
what: Posts and schedules to X, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Reddit, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord and more through your Postiz (self-hosted or postiz.com).

accounts.what: List the connected social accounts (their ids are what draft / post take).

upload.what: Upload a picture or video to Postiz's media library (every post's media must go through this first).

draft.what: Save a post as a DRAFT on the given accounts (nothing is published).

publish.what: Publish or schedule a post for real - LOKI shows the owner the exact post and accounts first.

notes: Needs Node.js. Set POSTIZ_API_KEY (and POSTIZ_API_URL for a self-hosted Postiz) in Settings. TikTok needs content_posting_method DIRECT_POST to actually publish. Every publish asks the owner.
verified_from: package.json (postiz 2.0.26, bin postiz) and SKILL.md command list at 17f1e27

name: OpenShorts (long video -> Shorts / Reels / TikToks)
what: Turns a long gameplay or devlog video into vertical clips with captions and hooks, through an OpenShorts server (self-hosted Docker, or openshorts.app).
license: MIT (the cloud/ folder is not - LOKI does not use it)

clip.what: Make short vertical clips from a video URL and wait for them.

list.what: List the clips a job made.

notes: Self-hosting: docker compose up in its repo, then OPENSHORTS_API_URL=http://localhost:8000; set LLM_BASE_URL on the server to an Ollama URL to run without a Google key. Posting goes through Postiz in LOKI (asks the owner).
verified_from: README.md 'CLI' section (pip install openshorts; process --wait; clips) at 9474289

name: Agent Sprite Forge (video -> game sprites -> Godot)
what: Keys an animation clip into clean registered sprite frames and packages them as atlases, Godot 4 SpriteFrames and Aseprite JSON.

video-to-frames.what: A character clip (green/solid background) -> keyed, registered sprite frames (needs ffmpeg).

package.what: Clean frames -> an engine package (PNG atlas + animation.json; webm/packed when ffmpeg can).

frames.what: a folder of RGBA PNG frames

install-skills.what: Give the Claude Code / Codex harness its sprite skills (generate2dsprite, video2dsprite ...).

notes: The full pipeline (master still -> image-to-video -> frames -> Godot) is a skill: install-skills hands it to the Claude Code / Codex harness; LOKI's own image and video makers supply the generation.
